articles.title: A 19-Year-Old Just Won the French Open—and Thanked Herself!
articles.summary: Mirra Andreeva, a 19-year-old from Russia, won the French Open tennis tournament. She beat Maja Chwalinska 6-3, 6-2. Andreeva is the youngest champion since 1992!

articles.title: Want a Summer Job? It's Tougher Than Ever for Teens in 2026!
articles.summary: Finding a summer job is really hard for teens this year. There are 219,000 fewer teen workers than last May. But one 19-year-old barista says working teaches you the value of money.

articles.title: Surprise! The U.S. Added 172,000 Jobs in May—Here's What's Going On
articles.summary: The U.S. job market surprised everyone in May by adding 172,000 jobs. That's way more than experts expected. But not everyone is feeling the good news.
